scope: IceWorld concept and developed-design presets. A passing check means that a modelling input is within its declared design profile, not that the building or an individual component is code-compliant.

temporary-exhibition.description: Visitor-facing temporary ice landscape circulation. It is not an alternative to project-specific fire egress or structural design.

stairWidth.clause: GB 55037-2022 7.1.4-3 for public indoor egress stairs; outdoor egress stairs use a separate 0.80 m floor and still require project egress calculation

guardHeight.clause: GB 55031-2022 6.6.1, measured to the top of the guard from the walkable surface

manualReview.requirement: Confirm GB 51202-2016 clauses for ice/snow material, construction, maintenance and site applicability against the current controlled edition.
manualReview.reason: The standard is current, but its material, structural and construction values require the actual controlled edition and project material tests rather than an excerpt-based check.

manualReview.requirement: Confirm the project location, indoor or outdoor setting and applicable Heilongjiang local standards or guidance.
manualReview.reason: DB23/T 3792-2024 applies to indoor ice landscape buildings, while the 2023 provincial planning and design guide has a broader planning scope.

manualReview.requirement: Calculate occupant load, exit count, travel distance and aggregate egress width for each project.
manualReview.reason: A single stair's width does not establish building egress compliance.

manualReview.requirement: Check ice structure stability, guard loads, fixings, support capacity and service conditions.
manualReview.reason: Concept Breps contain no structural resistance or connection design.

manualReview.requirement: Review freeze-thaw exposure, surface slip resistance, drainage, temporary closure and maintenance.
manualReview.reason: These depend on site operation and material testing.

manualReview.requirement: Define whether a route is required to be accessible and apply the relevant accessibility provisions.
manualReview.reason: Applicability depends on project function, route and local requirements.
